name: Outreach
description: Bring Outreach knowledge and actions into Claude so your teams can move faster, combine insights across systems, and complete advanced revenue tasks without switching tools. Outreach is an end-to-end AI Revenue Platform for all go-to-market teams. By embedding agentic AI across every revenue workflow, Outreach increases sales productivity, boosts pipeline, and gives leaders the visibility and predictability they need to grow revenue at scale.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Outreach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Outreach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.outreach.io/mcp/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Outreach MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outreach lists 15 MCP tools, including fetch_kaia_meetings, emails_search, sequence_search_by_name, prospect_get_by_id, prospect_search_by_name, prospect_search_by_ext_id, account_get_by_id, account_search_by_name, account_search_by_ext_id, opportunity_get_by_id, opportunity_search_by_name, and opportunity_search_by_ext_id.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Outreach?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Outreach in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Outreach requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Outreach is developed by Outreach. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
